title: RxCNC lab clients lose connection to CNC server, recover after restart
body:
Generators in the surfacing area reported "connection timed out" when sending jobs to RxCNC. A restart of the RxCNC service restored connectivity. Timeouts returned roughly 5–6 hours later on the same day.
Errors: ERR_CONN_TIMEOUT; Socket read timed out after 30000 ms
rootCause: Not confirmed. Engineer note: "possibly sockets left open by the job dispatcher".
resolution: Service restart provided temporary recovery. Ticket closed after 48 hours without recurrence.

title: Connection pool in RxCNC dispatcher does not release sessions after job abort
body:
Load test shows active sessions climbing from 40 to 512 (pool max) over ~4 hours when jobs are aborted mid-transfer. New requests then wait for a free session and time out.
Errors: Pool exhausted: 512/512 sessions in use; ERR_CONN_TIMEOUT
rootCause: Suspected: aborted jobs do not return their session to the pool.
resolution: Fix in development. Interim mitigation under discussion.

title: RxCNC Connectivity Troubleshooting Guide
body: Section 3: Check established and CLOSE_WAIT sockets on the RxCNC host. Section 4: Review the connection-pool metrics in the monitoring dashboard. Section 6: Confirm the license service and the SQL instance respond within thresholds.
resolution: Structured checks: sockets, application logs, service dependencies and monitoring.

title: RxCNC jobs stuck in "sending" at Lyon lab after Windows patching
body:
After the May patch window, jobs remained in "sending". Firewall rule for port 5021 had been reset by the patch baseline.
Errors: ERR_CONN_REFUSED
resolution: Re-applied firewall rule; added rule to the patch baseline.

title: RE: RxCNC timeouts again this afternoon – Dallas
body: Lab supervisor: "Restart fixed it again but it came back before shift change." Support engineer: "CLOSE_WAIT count was above 400 before the restart. I think something is not closing sockets."

title: Lab Systems channel: CLOSE_WAIT sockets on RXCNC-APP02
body: netstat on RXCNC-APP02 shows 431 CLOSE_WAIT sockets towards the dispatcher port. Count grows by ~90 per hour during peak.

title: Add connection-pool saturation alert for RxCNC dispatcher
body: Raise a warning when active sessions exceed 80% of pool size for more than 10 minutes.

title: Order Import API calls time out during month-end batch
body:
Order Import returned HTTP 504 from the ECM API gateway during the month-end batch. Gateway timeout was 30 s; batch calls took up to 48 s.
Errors: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout
rootCause: Gateway timeout lower than batch processing time.
resolution: Raised gateway timeout to 60 s for the batch route and split batches into 500-order chunks.

title: ECM API timeout handling and retry policy
body: Callers should retry idempotent requests with exponential back-off (2, 4, 8 s). Do not raise gateway timeouts above 60 s without architecture review.
resolution: Retry with back-off; batch large payloads.

title: Order launch fails with "lens design not found" for new VisionStar products
body:
Orders for the new progressive range failed at launch. Product catalogue sync to the lab had not run since the release.
Errors: Lens design not found
rootCause: Catalogue sync job disabled after release.

title: Order-launch failures: top causes and checks
body: Most frequent causes: missing catalogue data (38%), invalid frame tracing (24%), blocked by credit hold (17%), lab routing rule mismatch (12%).
resolution: Check catalogue sync, tracing validation, credit status and routing rules in that order.

title: Tristar print queue stops at Bangkok lab, jobs pile up
body:
Job tickets stopped printing. Spooler service hung on a corrupted job from the Tristar label template.
Errors: Spooler subsystem app has stopped
rootCause: Corrupted spool file from label template v3.2.
resolution: Cleared spool folder, restarted spooler, rolled template back to v3.1.

title: Print-queue recovery procedure for lab job tickets
body: Stop spooler, move files from the spool folder to quarantine, start spooler, re-send the last 20 jobs from Tristar.
resolution: Quarantine spool files, restart spooler, re-send jobs.

title: LABEX results upload intermittently rejected – no root cause recorded
body:
Measurement results upload rejected roughly 3% of the time with a schema validation error. Retrying usually succeeds.
Errors: Schema validation failed: field "axis"

title: Rx.Net sign-in loop for lab users after certificate renewal
body:
Users redirected back to the sign-in page repeatedly. Started after the identity certificate renewal.
Errors: AADSTS50011 reply URL mismatch

title: EOLP order launch retries create duplicate jobs in manufacturing labs
body:
When the first launch call times out, the retry creates a second job. Labs see duplicate lens pairs.
Errors: Duplicate job id
